task: Build a Python package named textstat in the working directory containing exactly six independent modules, each with its own pytest test file: slugify.py (title to URL slug), wordcount.py (word, character and sentence counts), truncate.py (truncate at a word boundary appending an ellipsis), normalize_ws.py (collapse repeated whitespace), titlecase.py (smart title casing), strip_html.py (remove HTML tags). Add an __init__.py. No cross-imports between modules. Then run py -m pytest -q and report the exact pass and fail counts.
label: single
